_note: Hand-maintained overlay over the source-mined catalogue (catalog/manychat-endpoints.source.json, 849 typed + 56 legacy requests from ManyChat's public source maps, bundle 490) and the public swagger. Keyed by WIRE IDENTITY 'METHOD /path' (internal) or 'PUBLIC METHOD /path'. `proven: live` = executed on a real account and the response read back (manychat-internal-api-research/knowledge/sniffs/live-*.json, 2026-09-02). Rows absent from the source but proven live (the legacy pre-zod endpoints the builder still calls) are ADDED here with `add:true`. A generator never writes this file.

POST /cms/createFlow.summary: Create an empty flow; returns flow.ns (content{ts}_{6}).

GET /cms/getFlows.summary: List automations with triggers, live status and stats per row.

GET /cms/getAvailableFilters.summary: Filter vocabulary for the automations list.

GET /flow/getFlowData.summary: Full flow: published contents, draft_batch, draft_coordinates, root, triggers (13 kinds).

POST /flow/setDraft.summary: REPLACE the whole draft; validates nothing (garbage is stored).

POST /flow/patchDraft.summary: Touch only the contents sent; removed:true deletes.

POST /flow/setName.summary: Rename; blank → 'name cannot be blank.'; >60 silently truncated.

POST /flow/publish.summary: Validate + publish a batch; upsert by _oid/content_id; ONE content_node_errors entry per call.

POST /growth-tools/createWidget.summary: Create a widget — QUERY params, empty body: widget_type=feed_comment_trigger&ns=&channel=instagram.
POST /growth-tools/createWidget.note: without channel=instagram → 'You should connect the Facebook channel…'; server ignores name=, mints its own widget{ts} namespace AND a stray 'Opt-In Message' flow; status starts initial

POST /growth-tools/setWidget.summary: Save widget settings — the WHOLE widget object as the body.

POST /growth-tools/setFlow.summary: Attach a widget to a flow {widget_id, flow_ns}.

POST /growth-tools/setDraftStatus.summary: Set widget status {widget_id, status}; active = LIVE on Instagram.
POST /growth-tools/setDraftStatus.note: draft proven; active never exercised here — user's word required

GET /keywords/list.summary: DM keyword rules for a channel (channel=instagram&repeatHash=1).

POST /keywords/createDraft.summary: Create a DRAFT keyword rule bound to a flow {ns, channel, keyword_rules}.
POST /keywords/createDraft.note: system keywords → 'Trying to rewrite system keyword rule'; unknown condition → HTTP 500

POST /keywords/update.summary: Replace a rule (send the full record from get).

POST /keywords/setStatus.summary: Set keyword status {rule_id, status}; live = ACTIVE.
POST /keywords/setStatus.note: never exercised here — user's word required

POST /tags/create.summary: Create a tag {tag_name, path:'/', client_id}; duplicate → 'Tag with the specified name already exists'.

POST /customFields/create.summary: Create a contact field {caption, type, description, path:'/'}; type ∈ text|number|date|datetime|boolean|array.

POST /globalFields/create.summary: Create a bot field {caption, type, description, path}.

POST /globalFields/changeValue.summary: Set a bot field's value {field_id, value}.

GET /subscribers/availableFields.summary: System + custom field vocabulary for conditions/tokens.

GET /subscribers/getAccountUserSubscribe.summary: The current account user's OWN contact record (if they are a subscriber).

GET /settings/data.summary: Account settings incl. the public API key (redacted by the server layer).

POST /content/createPreview.summary: Sends a PREVIEW to a real Instagram user.

PUBLIC POST /fb/sending/sendFlow.note: messages a real contact — confirm + user's word

POST /api/token/generate.summary: Mint the account's PUBLIC API key (Settings -> API); returns {token}. Replaces an existing key.
POST /api/token/generate.note: settings/data's settings.api_key is NOT this key — the public rail 401s 'Wrong token' for it (differential 2026-09-03). __INIT__ public_api_access_token is null until this is called.

POST /api/token/delete.summary: Delete the account's public API key.
POST /api/token/delete.note: never called by this server (no-delete house rule)

POST /content/upload.summary: Upload an image/video/file/gif (multipart); returns {attachment:{caid,title,type}} for an attachment block.
